# README image credits

The README pictures were drawn by OpenReadout from public test files listed in [`corpus/manifest.toml`](../../../corpus/manifest.toml). Each is used under its licence.

## Demo videos

- **Slide chat**: young mouse section, ZEISS sample images deposited for Bio-Formats. CC-BY-4.0. https://zenodo.org/records/10577621
- **Knockout chat**: Edyanto et al. CC-BY-4.0. https://doi.org/10.6084/m9.figshare.33265719
- **Terminal demo** (`demo.gif`): Allen Institute for Cell Science test resources. BSD-3-Clause.
